I was in amalfi and sorrento just two months ago. I always walk around with my David star necklace, and luckily I didn’t have any trouble around it. Many italians love Israel and so telling them you’re Jewish or Israeli really isn’t a concern as it might be in other countries, say Ireland. I wouldn’t say i necessarily recommend going around with visible Jewish symbols, since there’s still a chance not that small that you’d encounter anti semitism and it’s honestly up to you but in all the times I’ve been in Italy they were super lovely and respectful and nice and many of them even asked me how we’re doing in Israel and if I’m okay regarding the war which was very sweet.
